verdict.rationale: Yubico publishes extensive developer documentation, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. However, probes found no llms.txt on any Yubico host (all return HTTP 404). Appending .md returns HTTP 300 rather than markdown, so the docs are human-oriented HTML only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
